messages.content: RoboRide launches autonomous ride-share service in Millfield. Price: $0.18 per mile. Average wait time: 15 minutes. Coverage: main roads and commercial areas.
Auto sector revenue index: 89 (baseline: 100). Foot traffic and sales are somewhat down.

You Apply for Maria Chen's $5,000 small business stabilization grant. Fill out the full application this week. Frame it around the AV corridor impact on Auto Row-adjacent fuel retailers — which is exactly what the data supports. Do not over-dramatize. Do not under-state. Present the Phase 2 impact data from other cities as evidence. Have Priya review it before submission.. Savings grew by $665.
